title: A new default does not change an existing work order
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, that bills itself.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Estimate, that bills itself, created before the default is saved.
  • Start on customer A's page.
custom_steps:
1. Open customer A's Edit Customer window.
  2. In "Bill Invoices To", pick customer B.
  3. Click Save.
  4. Open work order 1.
  5. Expand the Customer card.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • "Bill Invoices To" reads "This customer".

Step 2:

  • The field shows customer B's name.

Step 3:

  • The window closes and customer A's left card shows "Bill Invoices To" with customer B's name.

Step 4:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 5:

  • The Customer card shows a "Bill To" field under Authorizer, reading "This customer".
  • Work order 1 still bills customer A, although customer A now has a default.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12303 (Story 1, Saved default Bill To on the customer page)

  • S1-R6: “Saving applies only to work orders and part sales created afterwards.”
  • Terminology: “Saved default Bill To → a customer-level setting ("Bill Invoices To") that sets the Bill To of new work orders and part sales for that customer. Never changes existing ones.”
  • Key Decisions: “A saved default Bill To, one hop, applied at creation only. Set in New Customer and Edit Customer; applied silently when a work order or part sale is created and shown on its Customer card.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
